title: Implement step result
description: What the implementer returns at the end of a factory run (factory/prompts/implement.md). The orchestrator validates it before applying any transition.

outcome.description: implemented: the work is in the tree and the gate passed. blocked: a decision is needed (see question). no_change: the behavior already holds, proven by the REQ tests.

summary.description: The PR description: what changed and why, for a reviewer who has read the issue.

commit_message.description: One-line commit subject in the repo's `area: description` style. Required when outcome is implemented.

question.description: For a maintainer, answerable in one reply, with the options seen. Required when outcome is blocked.

reqs.description: Each REQ ID the issue names, and the test that proves it.

unrelated_failures.description: Gate failures in code this run didn't touch.

followups.description: Problems noticed outside the issue's scope and deliberately left alone. Each may become a factory:triage issue.

needed.description: Anything the sandbox lacked that the run wanted: a tool, a service, access.
